label: host-associated
definition: Material taken from or produced by a host organism, including rhizosphere soil around living plant roots.

label: animal host
definition: Material taken from or produced by an animal other than a human.

label: human host
definition: Material taken from or produced by a human.

label: plant host
definition: Material taken from or produced by a plant, including rhizosphere soil around its living roots.

label: environmental
definition: Material from the environment outside a host, or an object or surface in a built environment.

label: food or feed
definition: Food for humans or feed for animals.

label: laboratory strain
definition: A bacterial strain that was kept, evolved, or engineered in a laboratory.
scope_note: Not for a new isolate from a natural or clinical source. Wording about culture, medium, plate, isolate, or a diagnostic laboratory does not qualify.

label: body fluid
definition: A liquid substance of a host body, including excreted liquids such as urine and pathological liquids such as pus.

label: human milk
definition: Mammalian milk produced by a human.
scope_note: Use only when evidence identifies human milk.

label: urine
scope_note: Cystocentesis urine also names the lower urinary tract.

label: drainage fluid
definition: Body fluid drained from a wound, a body cavity, or a fluid collection.
scope_note: Use when the metadata does not name the fluid. If the metadata names the fluid, or names a lesion that implies it, use that instead.

label: respiratory secretion
definition: A substance secreted by the respiratory system into the airways.

label: tracheal aspirate
definition: Respiratory secretion collected from the trachea by suction.

label: bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
definition: Fluid that is washed through the bronchi and alveoli of a lung and then recovered with the respiratory secretion in it.

label: digestive tract content
definition: Material taken from inside the digestive tract, usually at necropsy or slaughter.
scope_note: For passed stool, use feces. Also select the named site, for example caecum or intestine.

label: upper respiratory tract
scope_note: Do not use for sputum, which comes from the lower respiratory tract.

label: pharynx
definition: The part of the upper respiratory tract behind the nasal cavity and the mouth that is shared with the digestive tract.

label: upper urinary tract
definition: The kidneys and the ureters.

label: lower urinary tract
definition: The bladder and the urethra.

label: reproductive tract
definition: The part of the genitourinary system made up of the reproductive ducts and organs other than the gonads, such as the uterus and the vagina, and the external genitalia, such as the penis, the scrotum, and the vulva.

label: skeletal system
definition: The bones and the joints of the body.

label: bone
definition: A bone of the skeleton or the bone tissue it is made of.

label: skin and soft tissue
definition: Skin, soft tissue, or both, taken together as one clinical category.
scope_note: Use when the metadata names skin and soft tissue as one clinical category, or does not tell which of the two was sampled.

label: lower limb
scope_note: Includes the buttock, hip, thigh, knee, popliteal fossa, leg, ankle, heel, foot, and toes. Not the sacral region, which is part of the back.

label: upper limb
scope_note: Includes the shoulder, arm, elbow, forearm, wrist, hand, and fingers.

label: head
scope_note: Does not imply an organ of the head, such as the brain or the eye.

label: thorax
definition: The front and the sides of the trunk between the neck and the abdomen.
scope_note: Does not imply a thoracic organ, such as the lung or the heart.

label: back
definition: The rear of the trunk, including the lumbar and the sacral regions.
scope_note: Does not imply the vertebral column or the spinal cord.

label: abdomen
definition: The region of the trunk between the thorax and the pelvis, including the flank and the inguinal region.
scope_note: Does not imply an abdominal organ.

label: wound
definition: A break in the skin or another tissue caused by injury or surgery.

label: ulcer
definition: An open sore on the skin or a mucous membrane where the surface tissue is lost.

label: abscess
definition: A pus-filled cavity in a tissue.

label: cyst
definition: A closed sac that is empty or filled with fluid or semisolid material.
scope_note: Do not use for cystic fibrosis, cystitis, cystocentesis, a pseudocyst, or the cyst stage of an organism.

label: rhizosphere soil
definition: Soil directly around living plant roots and influenced by them.

label: wastewater
definition: Water discharged after domestic, industrial, or other human use, including the sludge from wastewater treatment.

label: sludge
definition: Semisolid residue separated from wastewater during its treatment.

label: healthcare facility
definition: A facility where people receive health care.

label: primary care facility
definition: A healthcare facility outside a hospital where people get first-contact care, such as a general practice.

label: long-term care facility
definition: A healthcare facility where residents receive long-term care, such as a nursing home or a care home.

label: veterinary facility
definition: A facility where animals receive veterinary care, such as a veterinary clinic or a veterinary hospital.

label: farm facility
definition: A building or other built structure on a farm, such as an animal house.

label: food production facility
definition: A built facility where food is produced, harvested, or processed.

label: food processing plant
definition: A food production facility where raw agricultural products are processed into food, in one or more buildings.

label: inanimate object
definition: A physical object that is not alive.

label: plumbing drain
definition: An inanimate object through which water drains into a plumbing system, such as a sink, floor, or shower drain.

label: equipment
definition: An inanimate object used as a tool or an apparatus, such as a machine, an instrument, a ventilator, or a monitor.

label: medical device
definition: A device placed in or on a patient, such as a catheter, a tube, a drain, or an implant.

label: surface
definition: The outer boundary of an object or structure in a built environment, such as a floor, a wall, or a bench.
scope_note: Use when the surface itself was sampled, not the whole object.

label: plant food product
definition: A food product made from plants or plant parts, such as fruit, vegetables, grain, or sprouts.

label: animal food product
definition: A food product made from an animal or from a substance that an animal produces.

label: dairy food product
definition: An animal food product that is milk or is made from milk, such as raw milk, cheese, or yogurt.

label: meat product
definition: An animal food product made from the flesh of land animals, such as beef, pork, or chicken.

label: seafood product
definition: An animal food product made from fish, shellfish, or other aquatic animals.

label: fermented food
definition: A food product made by microbial fermentation, such as sauerkraut, kimchi, or tempeh.

label: animal feed
scope_note: An organism named in feed is not the bacterial host.

label: disease
scope_note: Use only when the metadata states that the host is ill without naming the disease, such as "diseased" or "ill".

label: infection
scope_note: Use only when the metadata names an infection without its site or kind, such as "infection" or "invasive disease".

label: bacteremia
definition: Bacteria in the blood, also called a bloodstream infection.

label: sepsis
definition: A life-threatening response of the body to an infection, including septicemia and neonatal sepsis.

label: urinary tract infection
scope_note: Asymptomatic bacteriuria is colonization.

label: gastrointestinal infection
definition: An infection of the stomach or the intestine, such as gastroenteritis, diarrheal disease, dysentery, shigellosis, or an STEC infection.

label: intra-abdominal infection
definition: An infection in the abdomen outside the intestine, such as peritonitis, a liver abscess, or cholangitis.

label: skin and soft tissue infection
definition: An infection of the skin or the tissue under it, such as cellulitis, impetigo, a furuncle, or an infected wound or burn.
scope_note: A sampled wound or abscess alone is a lesion, not this diagnosis.

label: surgical site infection
definition: An infection of the incision or of the operated organ after surgery.

label: device-associated infection
definition: An infection of a device placed in a patient, such as a catheter, a prosthetic joint, or a cardiac device.

label: bone and joint infection
definition: An infection of a bone or a joint, such as osteomyelitis or septic arthritis.

label: meningitis
definition: Inflammation of the meninges caused by an infection.

label: ear infection
definition: An infection of the ear, such as otitis externa or otitis media.

label: reproductive tract infection
definition: An infection of the reproductive organs, such as endometritis, metritis, pyometra, or vaginitis.

label: cystic fibrosis
scope_note: Do not use for "non-CF" values.

label: bronchiectasis
scope_note: Non-CF bronchiectasis is bronchiectasis without cystic fibrosis.

label: colonization
definition: Bacteria live in or on the host without causing disease.
scope_note: Use for carriage, colonization, a screening sample, asymptomatic bacteriuria, or a healthy host.
